# X.page

X.page makes businesses citable by AI agents.

Live: https://x.page
Scan: https://x.page/scan

## Product
- Scan a business website for AI-agent discoverability.
- Score HTTPS, crawler access, business schema, readable text, and llms.txt quality.
- Host a structured business identity page that an AI agent can cite.
